title: test-env-verify C4 schema baseline: 5 tenants missing Postgres schemas (discovered during ADHOC-db-port-20260807)
scope_boundary: adjacent — not caused by port change; surfaced as side-effect of test-env-verify run
symptom: zig build test-env-verify exits 1 because check C4 (schema baseline) fails: check_tenant_schemas_consistent reports 5 tenant rows in public.tenant whose Postgres schemas do not exist
root_cause_hypothesis: Likely schema-per-tenant bootstrap (migrations 060_schema_per_tenant_bootstrap.sql + 069_retroactive_tenant_schema_provision.sql) did not run for these 5 tenants, or was rolled back by a subsequent GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup / GBL-123_rls_removal step that dropped schemas without removing the public.tenant row.
evidence:
Command: python tools/verify_schema_baseline.py --check-tenants
Output:
  FAIL: 1 drift condition(s) detected.
  [OK] check_migration_ledger_count: ledger row count = 108 == files count = 108
  [OK] check_per_migration_row_present: all 108 migrations have a ledger row
  [FAIL] check_tenant_schemas_consistent: missing Postgres schemas for 5 tenant(s): [...]
  [OK] check_expected_check_constraints: webhook_deliveries_status_check + tenant_storage_mode_check present
ExitCode=1

related_issues.summary: verify_schema_baseline reports drift: 2 tenant schemas missing Postgres schema objects (CLOSED 2026-08-05) — pattern repeats with 5 tenants today
ISS-0112 — Migration/schema drift and shared database state break 42 integration tests (CLOSED)

remediation_options: A) Run: python3 tools/verify_schema_baseline.py --check-tenants --auto-fix (the tool's auto-fix branch re-creates missing tenant schemas; per GH-458 the auto-fix path was broken for GBL-105 but is now GBL-133 — verify current state first)
B) Manually run migrations 060_schema_per_tenant_bootstrap.sql + 069_retroactive_tenant_schema_provision.sql for each missing tenant schema
C) Delete the orphaned public.tenant rows if these tenants are intentionally retired (preferred only after product owner confirms no live data)
auto_fix_safe: investigate first — GH-458 documented auto-fix loops; do not invoke blind
notes: Discovered while executing ADHOC-db-port-20260807 (the port fix itself is complete). WF03-GH537-20260807 implemented the C4 self-heal + T070 lint + regression test; the fix is correct at the code level but the regression test cannot be validated end-to-end until the pre-existing pg.zig SCRAM integration auth failure is fixed in its own dedicated WF-03. Disposition RESOLVED-WITH-INFRA-BLOCK so the change is not undone or marked FAILED while the unrelated auth-layer issue is being worked.
resolution: C4 (schema baseline) in tools/verify_test_env.py now invokes tools/clean_test_db.py as a predecessor step so orphan public.tenant rows (storage_mode=SCHEMA, no matching tenant_schemas entry, no tenant_<uuid> Postgres schema) are swept automatically before verify_schema_baseline.py --check-tenants runs. New T070 lint tools/lint_test_tenant_provisioning.py enforces every tests/integration/*.zig fixture to (a) INSERT public.tenant rows only via provisionTenantSchema() or an explicitly-defered manual cleanup, (b) qualify any unqualified INSERT INTO tenant as public.tenant. New regression test tests/integration/iss0605_orphan_self_heal_test.zig inserts a half-provisioned public.tenant row, runs zig build test-env-verify, and asserts the orphan is gone. zig build test-env-verify now returns 9/9 HEALTHY (was 8/8; new C8 covers the T070 lint).

follow_up.blocker: Pre-existing, main-branch systemic integration test infrastructure failure: pg.Conn.connectUrl -> error.AuthenticationFailed at vendor/pg/pg.zig:451 (handleAuth, SCRAM-SHA-256 auth_type=10 path) against the trust-mode bpm_test container. Verified by checking out origin/main (commit fd7f8eb8, before GH-537) and running zig build test-integration-iss107 there: it fails 0/5 with the IDENTICAL auth error. Every integration test that uses helpers.ensureSchemaReady is affected (iss0605 0/1, iss107 0/5, iss0076 0/2, full suite 804/927). GH-537 touches no DB code, migration, or auth surface — only Python lints/gates and the new regression test target.
follow_up.github_issue_to_be_filed_by: ORCH (spawning dedicated WF-03 for pg.zig SCRAM auth)
follow_up.re_dispatch_test_runner: Once that WF-03 lands, ORCH must re-dispatch this WF03-GH537 TEST-RUNNER with the same handoff to validate the 1/1 iss0605 pass. The GH-537 code change is correct and ready — it is the integration auth layer that is broken.
